Welcome to this journey across the American West—a place where the land itself holds centuries of tradition, hope, and struggle.
Imagine standing on the sweeping plains, feeling the weight of history all around you. That’s the world we’ll explore together through Bury My Heart at Wounded Knee, written by Dee Brown.
This isn’t just a story about change—it’s an invitation to see through the eyes of Native American nations in the late nineteenth century. We’ll walk beside tribal leaders, warriors, and families as they face relentless expansion, heartbreak, and moments of breathtaking resilience.
What happens when treaties are broken, when migrations are forced, and when a people’s way of life is threatened at every turn? These chapters bring us up close to the heartbreak and the hope, the resistance and the dignity, woven through every moment.
As we move from the Great Plains to the Black Hills and beyond, we’ll feel the impact of land dispossession and cultural erasure—and we’ll hear the voices of Sitting Bull, Crazy Horse, and so many others whose stories echo far beyond Wounded Knee.
Together, we’ll discover not just a chronicle of loss, but a powerful testament to survival. This is a chance to uncover the true legacy of the American West, and to honor the enduring spirit that continues to inspire us all.
